mentions.name: Translucent
mentions.description: An accounting agent factory: a harness and infrastructure for long-running AI agents that process accounting books containing thousands of invoices and transactions.
mentions.problem: Processing accounting books with thousands of invoices and transactions is challenging, in particular due to the long-running nature of the work.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on an accounting agent factory (https://www.translucent.io) .
Building a harness and infra that can process books with thousands of invoices, transactions, etc. is quite rewarding and challenging. In particular the long-running nature of things.
mentions.author: BrandiATMuhkuh
